description: This file defines an internal interface 'ILogConsistencyProtocolGateway' within the 'Orleans.SystemTargetInterfaces' namespace. The interface acts as a relay for forwarding protocol messages between clusters in an Orleans-based system, specifically handling log consistency protocol messages.

classes.name: ILogConsistencyProtocolGateway
classes.description: An internal interface serving as a protocol relay that forwards incoming log consistency protocol messages to the appropriate grain within the cluster.

methods.name: RelayMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously relays a log consistency protocol message to a specified grain identified by 'id'.
